title: Ontology rule-coverage authoring and re-evaluation
status_justification: After authoring curated, auditable rule packs, the real ontology scorer's standalone ranking on benchmark-v2 rose from chance (ROC-AUC 0.5013) to 0.7881 (95% CI [0.7743, 0.8016], CI clears 0.50), and combined_real_ontology (0.6581) now exceeds detector_only (0.4247). Rules use only model-visible clinical content + demographics (no labels/hidden/audit metadata); normal false-positive rate is 0.13. IMPORTANT NUANCE: combined_real_ontology (0.658) is BELOW ontology_only_real (0.788) because the SMOKE-SCALE detector (0.425, below chance, weight 0.7) drags the combination down -- so the ontology is a strong STANDALONE ranker, but the calibrated combination is not yet best until a full-scale detector replaces the smoke one.

rules.mechanism: Anchored on SOURCE ICD diagnosis-code family (pregnancy O*/Z3A, prostate N40-N53, etc.) vs model-visible gender; plus a clean SNOMED pregnancy subtree. Avoids the lossy many-to-many crosswalk.

Therapeutic anticoagulants (warfarin/DOACs/enoxaparin) -> thromboembolic/AF context; levothyroxine -> hypothyroid; insulin (by source-token name, since bare MED_INSULIN is UNMAPPED) -> diabetes context.
rules.precision: weak/noisy by design (insulin also used for ICU hyperkalaemia; prophylactic anticoagulation lacks an active-clot dx). med-mismatch recall ~0.50.

rules.mechanism: type-1 (E10*) vs type-2 (E11*) co-occurrence via SNOMED concept groups AND source-token ICD families (catches the non-standard injected E10_9 body that fails to map).
rules.precision: medium (forbidden-anomaly recall 100%; normal FP ~6.7% reflects real-EHR co-coding, hence severity 0.5).

rule_packs.precision_engineering: Crosswalk-derived concept groups are keyword-filtered (term must name the sex/type) and exclude secondary 'X in pregnancy' / 'X due to type N diabetes' concepts, because generic codes cross-map to those variants. This cut normal FP from 0.75 (naive groups) to 0.13.

leakage_protections.scorer_inputs: OntologyAwareScorer real mode reads only {codes, gender, age_group}; source_tokens carry only model-visible diagnosis/med tokens.

verdict.reason_combination_not_best: smoke-scale detector (0.425) is below chance and weighted 0.7; it dilutes the strong ontology term. A full-scale detector is required before the calibrated combination can be claimed as best.

next_step: Phase 4 may proceed (leakage-free counterfactual repair), with the caveat that the unsupervised detector must be trained at FULL scale in a later experiment phase before the calibrated COMBINATION (not just the ontology term) can be presented as the headline. Do not start H200 or large final training now.
